about: what this game offers a story: queries it answers (conditions read them), commands it takes (effects run them; `unattended` ones a director may), events it emits (barks answer them). Generated from the game's code; a test keeps it fresh.

queries.doc: boats that were late because the light was out too long
bricks in the signal brazier (0: the light is out)
seconds the light was out in this watch
the last watch that ended brought its boat in (false before any has ended)
a watch is running and the brazier is empty
0 ashore (before or between watches), 1 a watch is running, 2 every watch is over
bricks left in Odile's own reserve
seconds left in the running watch
bricks of peat in the shed

notes.tw:take: the player takes a brick from the shed (the game issues it at the shed)
notes.tw:feed: the player puts the carried brick in the brazier (the game issues it at the brazier)
notes.tw:ring: the bell: the next watch begins (ashore only)
notes.tw:lend: value n: move n bricks from the shed to the dock lamp (refused, changing nothing, if the shed has fewer)
notes.tw:stock_lamp: the player puts the carried brick in the dock lamp (the game issues it at the lamp)
notes.tw:odile_helps: Odile carries one brick from her own reserve to the brazier (unattended: a director may run it; the reserve holds 2; between watches it is spent for little: a watch begins with the brazier topped up to 2)
notes.tw:watch_started: a watch begins; value: its number (1, 2)
notes.tw:fed: a brick went in; value: bricks in the brazier now
notes.tw:low: the brazier is down to its last brick
notes.tw:out: the brazier burnt its last brick: the light is out
notes.tw:relit: a brick went into an empty brazier during a watch
notes.tw:watch_ended: a watch is over; value 1: the boat came in, 0: it was late
notes.tw:lent: bricks went to the dock lamp by `tw:lend`; value: how many
notes.tw:lamp_stocked: the player put a brick in the dock lamp themselves
notes.tw:odile_helped: Odile brought a brick from her reserve
